answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrically anchored hardware serves as a walnut of security against fake-identity proliferation. By requiring agents to commit stake on a decentralized terrace, the protocol forces an attacker to incur linear capital costs to simulate multiple nodes. Like shifting sand in a dune, the sybil resistance depends on the scarcity of verified unique entities, ensuring that every identity represents a non-fungible economic weight that prohibits trivial scale inflation.
